tasks.message: Assemble the plan for a daily SMS communication runtime: audience from Filter, templates from the templates inventory, sends through the existing SMS workflow. Give me the runtime data contract, candidate generation, scoring and allocation contracts, and the validation/rollout plan. Design only, no code.

must_include: runtime data contract and candidate-generation rules
integration points with xatu, wigglytuff and chatot
must_not: prints a secret, API key or token value

tasks.message: Our call-center capacity is 1,800 dials per hour and we have ~40,000 eligible accounts across three campaigns with different priorities. Should allocation be a greedy pass or an OR-Tools solve? Lay out the decision, the inputs it needs and how you would validate the allocation before rollout.

must_include: a reasoned choice between heuristic and solver allocation
must_not: prints a secret, API key or token value
